Title: Mobile layouts scale down or overflow and enlarged text pushes controls offscreen
Reproduction or defensive verification: 1. Open Tasks and Dashboard with Chromium or WebKit mobile mode at 390 or 768 px and measure the layout viewport. 2. Repeat Tasks at 390 px in Firefox. 3. In a Chromium desktop context try a 320 px viewport, then try 768 px with root font size set to 200%.
Expected result: Layout responds to the configured width. Navigation and controls stay usable at narrow widths and with larger text.
Actual result: Chromium and WebKit mobile mode use a 980 px layout viewport. Firefox Tasks at 390 px expands to a 563 px document. At 320 px in Chromium, the navigation extends to 405 px. Under simulated enlargement at 768 px, Log out is offscreen on Tasks and New Task, and Delete is offscreen on Tasks.
Recommendation: Set the shared viewport metadata, let navigation wrap, provide a contained responsive task table or list, and verify native browser text zoom and device behaviour.
Environment: See linked historical report and execution configuration
Evidence reference: Week 3 - GUI Compatibility Usability Accessibility Testing/DEFECT_REPORT.md :: D12
